problemSigns.detail: The motor runs, but the door does not move. This often points to a stripped drive gear.
The door starts to close, then reverses before reaching the floor. This typically indicates a misaligned or obstructed safety sensor.
Your controls do not activate the opener. This could be a logic board issue or a problem with the receiver.
The indicator lights on your safety sensors flash. This signals a blockage or misalignment between the two sensor units.
The opener's trolley moves along the rail, but the door remains stationary. A disconnected or broken trolley carriage is likely the cause.
